description: Fetch one third-party library source card by id. Output is one object: id, title, publisher, authors, date_published (YYYY-MM-DD or null), url, type, category, status, summary, tags, verified_at, and featured only when it is true. Parameter id is required and must match sources[].id from search_sources, or a list_changes entry of kind library (those ids have no prefix). Example: lightning-labs-l402-for-agents. A missing id is rejected as invalid input. An unknown id returns isError with text No source with id <id>. A failed library read returns isError whose text is the Error message. Use search_sources instead when you have no id or need a filtered list (limit 1-50, no offset). Use list_categories instead when you need the category list. Use get_article instead for this site's own articles. Use list_changes instead for changelog rows. Free, no auth.

id.description: Required. Source id exactly as in search_sources sources[].id, e.g. lightning-labs-l402-for-agents. Case and hyphens must match. Library changelog ids have no prefix. A missing id is invalid input. An unknown id returns isError text No source with id <id>.

name: get_source
title: Get one library source
